candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Trigon Property Development reported a significant deterioration in financial performance in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Full-year revenue and gross profit from land sales were both zero, compared with gain on sales of €331,920 and gross profit of €220,299 in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The prior-year sales comprised a 0.09-hectare transport land plot sold for €31,920 and a 0.70-hectare property sold for €300,000.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: With no comparable sales in 2025, the company recorded an operating loss of €108,021, reversing an operating profit of €161,649 in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The company’s net result changed from a profit of €167,409 in 2024 to a loss of €99,507 in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Fourth-quarter performance also weakened, with a net loss of €23,333 compared with a profit of €154,215 in the fourth quarter of 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Basic and diluted earnings per share declined from €0.03721 to negative €0.02212.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Reported return on assets fell from 8.93% to -5.51%, while return on equity declined from 9.03% to -5.67%.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Administrative and general expenses increased to €108,021 from €63,650 in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The report identifies €41,452 of board remuneration in 2025, compared with none in 2024, as well as higher accounting, stock exchange, land-tax and property-related costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The company also purchased €12,000 of services from entities controlled by supervisory board members, compared with €3,240 in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Financial income increased to €8,513 from €5,760, but this was insufficient to offset the operating loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Operating cash flow turned negative, with €142,945 used in 2025 compared with €194,723 generated in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Inventories increased from €1.47 million to €1.56 million because €91,262 was invested in the development project; no inventory write-downs were recorded.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Total assets decreased to €1.80 million from €1.87 million, while equity fell to €1.76 million from €1.85 million following the annual loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Liabilities increased to €49,389 from €18,906, and the debt ratio rose from 1.01% to 2.74%.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: The company continues to own one 13.2-hectare Pärnu development project intended for a commercial, industrial and logistics park.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Management plans to continue selling the existing land plots and does not plan to start a new business activity next year.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: The share price increased modestly from €0.620 to €0.634, raising market capitalisation from €2.79 million to €2.85 million, despite the weaker earnings and lower book value per share.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K8 are all PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K6 and K7 are MISSING entirely – there is no mention of the planning amendment or shareholder structure changes. Despite two HIGH importance items missing, the majority of HIGH importance criteria are covered, and the main financial picture (losses, cash, inventory, equity) is captured. This justifies a score of 3 (Generally yes).
